primary_direction: lower is hypothesized better; evaluate, do not assume
motion_channel: obs/robot0_joint_pos, seven Panda joint angles in radians
time_basis: Low-dimensional datasets have no original timestamps. Reconstruct the simulation control grid from env_kwargs.control_freq for derivative calculation only; not evidence of real sensor timing quality.
mh_model: Two ordered thresholds on the primary metric only, selected on development balanced accuracy. Higher smoothness cost predicts lower proficiency. No feature selection on holdout.
paired_labels: Any positive stored reward defines success; labels are evaluation-only and excluded from predictors.
paired_comparison: Use exact first-state SHA256 matches with one success and one failure for matched comparisons; report unmatched/excluded counts.
integrity_control: Scan dimensions, row counts and finite numbers independently of task labels. Do not map Panda data to the G1 three-camera grade.
fault_injection: For each original trajectory length, reconstruct a 20 Hz grid then inject an early +0.2 ms shift and a later +2.2-frame shift. Also check clean and warning-only controls. These are synthetic corruption tests, not real timing faults in the public datasets.
decision: Only verified deterministic evidence checks are candidates for integration. A semantic grade from smoothness is experimental; report failed hypotheses and do not promote without generalization evidence.
